name: Sector 23A
shortDescription: Budget-to-mid-range residential belt with a large number of apartment complexes.
longDescription:
Sector 23A, Gurgaon is a well-established residential locality offering excellent connectivity, convenient amenities and a peaceful living environment. The area is ideal for families looking for comfortable homes, independent houses and premium builder floors.

The locality enjoys easy access to Palam Vihar, Sector 22, Sector 23, Dwarka Expressway and major commercial hubs of Gurgaon. Residents benefit from nearby schools, hospitals, local markets, shopping centres, restaurants and public transportation.

Whether you are looking to buy, sell or rent a property, Sector 23A offers attractive residential options with good connectivity and everyday convenience.
